scope: Difficulty profiles, bilingual settings, live changes, legacy saves, first-era novice policy; no claim about human win rates or later-era balance.

noviceBalance.policy: Every 5 simulation seconds, recruit a fixed two-frontline/one-ranged cycle and send one army to the nearest known non-player subsidiary, then the enemy main. Reissue only for a changed objective or a new/idle soldier. No ability, formation or counter micro; only legitimately visible ownership and the public authored map.
noviceBalance.scope: Independent first-era missions, using only the initial skill budget; later campaign upgrades are deliberately excluded. Results measure this policy, not human success rates.
